Grants Lightweight Frame bonuses. Deals 40% increased damage against Rank-and-File Combatants (compared to Exotic Primary's 30%)

Fires Harvester Spikes in a straight line, dealing 43 [39] Impact Damage, and up to 697 [91] Explosive Damage, down to 30% damage over 5 meters.
Minibosses, Champions, and Bosses become impaled on direct hits, being dealt 79 Damage every 0.8 seconds up to 6 times over 4 seconds.
Impaled Enemies trigger the Harvester Spike Explosion on the sixth tick, removing the impaled projectile.
Impale Damage is non-lethal. There is no limit to the amount of simultaneous impales on a single enemy.

Kills create a floating Vestige that home in towards the user. Picking up a Vestige grants Vestigial Alchemy Energy.
Picking up 7 Vestiges totals 50% Vestige Energy. Requires an additional 10 Vestiges (17 Total) to reach 100% Energy.
Impaled Minibosses, Champions, and Bosses spawn a Vestige every time Impale damage ticks, spawning up to 6 Vestiges on a single shot.

Holding [Reload] while Vestigial Alchemy is at least at 50% Energy toggles between Firing Modes.
50%–99% Vestigial Energy: Regular Fire -> Special Ammo Mode | 100% Vestigial Energy: Regular Fire -> Special Ammo Mode -> Heavy Ammo Mode
Ammo-Loaded Shots deplete Vestigial Alchemy Energy, and always explode on hit, meaning they cannot impale Combatants.

Special Ammo Mode: Causes the next shot to spawn a Special Ammo Brick for the user and their allies. Consumes 50% Vestigial Energy.
Special Vestige Ammo Bricks grant 10% of Total Reserves and are affected by Scavenger mods.

Heavy Ammo Mode: Causes the next shot to spawn a Heavy Ammo Brick for the user and their allies. Consumes 100% Vestigial Energy.
Heavy Vestige Ammo Bricks grant 10% of Total Reserves and are affected by Scavenger mods.

entries.name: Barrow-Dyad
entries.inGame:
Craftable Strand Aggressive Submachine Gun
Behaves differently depending on the current Path.

Automatically refills magazine-based Ammo every 0.2 seconds while not firing, refilling up to 34 Ammo over 4.85 seconds.
1-2 Ammo = 4 Refill per tick | 3-8 Ammo = 3 Refill | 9-16 Ammo = 2 Refill | 17 or higher = 1 Refill
Firing delays refilling to 0.285 seconds. Can fire permanently at 1 Ammo at 240?RPM. Refills to 34 Ammo to not prevent reloading.

Dealing damage charges Blight at a rate of 2% Blight per damage instance, reaching 100% Blight after dealing damage 50 times.
Blight decays at a rate of 3.33% every 1.2 seconds after not firing for 1.3 seconds, fully decaying after 41.1 seconds.
Grants increased Reload Speed based on the amount of Blight Seekers prepared.
Blight charge persists through stow, and decays normally.

On Reload:
Triggers Panic Response, converting all stored Blight into Blighted Seekers, at a rate of 1 Seeker for every 16.7% Blight, up to a maximum of 6 Seekers.
Always rounds up to the nearest Seeker number. Eg: 1% Blight = 1 Seeker, 52% = 4 Seekers, 84% = 6 Seekers.
Blight Seekers are fired at a rate of 450RPM Hipfire | 720RPM ADS, overwriting regular shots.
Panic Response lasts for 7 seconds, and persists through stow.

Taken Resolution
Dealing damage to 3 enemies within ? seconds of each grants 50% Blight.
Blighted Seekers deal 173 [6.85 Guardians | 81 Constructs] Damage over 3? meters on hit.
Blight Seekers pierce through enemies, seeking a maximum of 2 additional enemies within 10? meters of each.
Seekers can re-target enemies already hit by them.

Taken Ambition
Scoring 12 damage instances within 1 seconds of each on a single enemy or construct grants 22% Blight. Due to rounding, dealing damage 24 times is enough to grant 6 Seekers.
Blighted Seekers explode on impact, dealing 45 [9?] Impact Damage and 542 [21?] Explosive Damage over 0.25? meters.

↑Selectable Retrofit:
Grants the option to slot-in High-Impact Reserves, Hatchling, One For All, or Target Lock trait equivalents.

Releasing [Fire], or holding down the trigger for 0.4 seconds upon reaching 100% Charge shoots the weapon, fully emptying the Anticipation meter.

Anticipation:
Meter that charges over 160 seconds at base, which decreases the time needed to charge the weapon.
Dealing Kinetic Slot and Energy Slot Weapon Damage speeds up the rate at which Anticipation is filled, down to a minimum of 3 seconds to reach 100% Anticipation.
0% Anticipation = 4.85 seconds | 20% Anticipation = 4.25s | 40% Anticipation = 3.75s
60% Anticipation = 3.15 seconds | 80% Anticipation = 2.5s | 100% Anticipation = 2s.

entries.name: Restoration
entries.inGame:
Continuously restores health. Effect is uninterruptible and can be extended up to 15 seconds by default.
x1 = 35 [17.5] HP/s | x2 = 50 [25] HP/s
Healing Effect does not stack with Healing Rift.

Reapplying Restoration will refresh its duration to its longest achieved duration, keeping the highest Restoration stack.
If the new duration is longer than the previous longest, the new duration is used instead.
Eg: If the maximum Restoration duration achieved was 15 seconds, a Phoenix Dive or Healing Grenade will refresh it to 15 seconds.
Using a Phoenix Dive after using a Healing Grenade will refresh its duration to 4+2 seconds.
Empyrean and Mercy are both duration extenders, and do not count as reapplying Restoration. Extending a Solar Effect that is at >15 seconds will set it to 15 seconds.

entries.inGame:
Explosion that deals 676 [120 Guardians | 250 Construct] Solar Damage in a 8 meter radius without [with] damage falloff.
Ignitions remove all Scorch, and incur a 1.6 second cooldown before Scorch can be reapplied.

Ignition damage can be increased through certain damage increases if the initial Scorch source had a damage increase.
Eg: Verity's Brow x5 + Fusion Grenade = 100% Increased Ignition Damage.
Melee Damage Buffs do not scale Ignition nor Scorch damage.

All Scorch is removed upon reaching x100 Scorch to trigger an Ignition.
The 2nd Scorch tick has a 0.93s delay for some reason.

Scorch Stack Damage Scaling per Tick:
2.7 + (0.175 * Scorch Stacks) | Non-Boss Combatants receive 20% increased damage.
x1 = 3 | x30 = 5 | x50 = 6.5 | x60 = 7.21 | x80 = 8.64 | Scorch Damage is non-lethal.
Deals 2.5% increased damage upon reaching at least x60 Scorch, indicated by Yellow Damage Numbers.

Scorch duration and decay rate is difficulty-dependent.
Scorch lasts for 2.3 seconds, then decreases by x1 stacks every 0.04 seconds (-25/s)

entries.name: Solar Effect Damage Scaling
entries.inGame:
Solar Effect (Scorch | Ignition) damage can be increased through Perks and Exotics, but the source used for initially scorching will determine what it will be counted as.

Inflicting a Solar Effect with a Weapon, such as with Incandescent/Burning Ambition or through Exotic Weapons such as Tommy's Matchbook or Conditional Finality, will result in Solar Effects counting as Weapon Damage, benefitting from Weapon Buffs and Activity Modifiers that exclusively benefit Weapons, such as other Damage Perks, Weapon Stat, Radiant, and Solar Weapon Surges.
New Gear Bonus is applied permanently to all Weapons, so all Solar Effect Damage against Combatants will always be 5% higher than expected, on top of Combatant Rank Scalars.

Inflicting Solar Effects through abilities such as Fusion Grenades and Well of Radiance will result in the Solar Effects counting as Solar Ability Damage, with their damage only being increased by Grenade (Verity's Brow), and Super (Heart of the Flame) Damage Increases respectively. Melee Damage Buffs and 100+ Melee Stat do not increase Solar Effect Damage.
Effects that increase all Ability Damage will benefit all Solar Effects that are initially applied through Solar Abilities.

Activity Modifiers that increase all Solar Damage, such as Solar Surge, will also apply to Solar Effects, regardless of source.

entries.name: Invisibility
entries.inGame:
Cloaks the user, granting various benefits, while lowering Maximum Radar Range to 24 meters for 5+2 seconds. Immediately ends upon performing an Offensive Action.
Radar Booster Weapon Mod removes the Radar Reduction. Reapplying Invisibility without it breaking refreshes the duration of the longest lasting invisibility.

Combatants are unable to directly target the user, preferring to either shoot at the user's last visible location, or not firing. Combatants will track through Loud Actions, but not fire.

Guardians are unable to see the user's health bar, and the user's radar will only ping every 5 seconds for 0.6 seconds, or upon performing Loud Actions.

Weapons and Abilities that are able to home in (Tracking Projectiles) or scan (Firebolt Grenades) for enemies will not target the user, and will stop tracking if they already were.

Offensive Actions: Instantly ends Invisibility
Shooting | Grenade, Melee, Super, or Blink Ability Usage | Barricade or Rift Placement | Vehicle Summon

Loud Actions: Pings Radar | Combatants Track
Beginning Sprint | Non-Blink Movement Ability Usage | Hunter Class Ability Usage

Stability, Handling, Reload Speed and Recoil Direction are decreased by 75%.

Eg: 160 Reload Speed will be reduced be 40 Reload Speed. 80 Handling would be reduced to 20 Handling.

Frozen Enemies are completely immobilized, rendering them unable to shoot, use abilities, or move.
Frozen Enemies receive 10% increased damage from Special and Power Weapons, 5% increased damage from Arc, Solar, and Void Abilities, and 5% [60%] decreased damage from Primary Weapons.
Frozen Rank-and-File and Elite Combatants and Guardians receive 120% increased Basic Melee and Glaive Melee Attack Damage, on top of the aforementioned effects.

Frozen Enemies shatter after receiving varying [200] damage.

Frozen Enemies are immobilized for 6 [1.35 to 4.75] seconds.
Boss Combatants are unhindered by freeze and automatically shatter after 3 seconds.
Grounded Guardians can cast their Super Ability to instantly break out.

Brief Freeze:
Guardians frozen by other Guardians are frozen for 1.35 seconds

Prolonged Freeze:
Guardians that become frozen by Combatants, or by Stasis Super Abilities, are frozen for 4.75 seconds.
Frozen Guardians have their Class Ability replaced with Breakout, which allows breaking out of the long-lasting freeze, in exchange for ? Health.
Guardians that are frozen during a Roaming Super automatically break out after a second, while One-off Supers get deactivated if frozen during the cast animation.

Construct with ? HP that can exist for up to 20 seconds before dissipating.

Threadlings return after travelling 14 metres if they do not start chasing an enemy, remaining perched on the Warlock, up to a maximum of 5 Threadlings.

Unique ability obtained upon utilizing enough Light and Darkness damage types.
Kinetic Damage fills both Light and Darkness bars at 50% decreased rate. Overkill Damage isn't counted for Transcendence gains.
Having one full Alignment bar makes Kinetic Damage fill the remaining bar with at 40% decreased rate.

Dealing damage, alongside applying Elemental Effects grants Transcendence Energy.
Applying Elemental Effects, both buffs and debuffs, grant Transcendence Energy to their corresponding alignment.

Instantly recharges 2 Grenade and Melee Ability Charges on activation.
Replaces Grenade Ability with an unique class-specific Prismatic Grenade Ability with Light and Darkness damage types.
Grants 5% Increased Weapon Damage, an additional 10% Grenade and Melee Regeneration Speed, and 20% [5%] Damage Resist for 20 seconds.
Damage Increase stacks with everything.

Dealing Grenade Ability Damage while Transcendent increases the Melee Regeneration Speed to 35% Fixed Melee Ability Energy per second for 2 seconds.
Dealing Melee Ability Damage while Transcendent increases the Prismatic Grenade Regeneration Speed to 35% Prismatic Grenade Ability Energy per second for 2 seconds.

Kills while Transcendent extend its duration, with the amount extended decreasing as more kills are scored.
Tier 1 and T2 Combatants = 5% | T3 and T4 = 10% | T3 Elites, Minibosses and Bosses = 15% | Guardians = ?%

Elemental Effects include all of the verbs that subclasses apply that can either positively (Buff) or negatively (Debuff) affect a target.

Equipping any Strand Ability or Aspect allows the creation of Tangles, and Warlocks are able to possess Perched Threadlings.

Arc = ↑Amplified ↑Bolt Charge ↓Blind ↓Jolt | Ionic Trace

Void = ↑Devour ↑Invisibility ↑Void Overshield ↓Suppression ↓Volatile ↓Weaken | Void Breach

Spawns a Strand Decoy.

Decoy has 175 Construct HP and lasts for up to 12 seconds. Combatants are lured to attack it, and has 70% Damage Resist against Combatants.
Allies and Caster deal 150% increased Ability and Weapon Damage towards it.
Decoy always counts as hostile and can be damaged by allies, enemies, and the caster. Does not activate any On-Kill effect.

Upon losing all HP or when an enemy is within ? metres:
Deals up to 600 [60 Guardians | 121 Objects] damage in a ? metre radius.
Explosions triggered by enemies being near it spawn 2 Threadlings.

Passively applies 0.6x Class Ability Regeneration Speed while equipped.
entries.inCalculator: Left out: Does not work against a boss.

entries.name: Touch of Flame
entries.inGame:
Enhances certain Grenade types:

Healing Grenades grant Cure x2 and Restoration x2 for 4+2 seconds.
Firebolt Grenades seek radius is increased by 50% to 12 meters and target up to 5 enemies.
Solar Grenades linger for 2 seconds longer and release Magma Orbs that deal 125 [50] damage each. Magma Orbs do not have damage falloff.
Fusion Grenades explode again after 0.5 seconds, dealing up to 851 [50] damage in a 8 metre radius.
entries.inCalculator: Needs a keyword the calculator does not have yet. Active the whole damage phase. Changes an ability; Aegis measured the variant.

entries.name: Touch of Thunder
entries.inGame:
Enhances certain Grenade types:

Flashbang: Explodes an additional time on impact, dealing up to 684 [?] damage, down to 0% damage over 7.5 meters, and inflicting blind to enemies within 5 meters.

Lightning: Grants an additional Grenade Charge, lightning strikes after the first inflict jolt, and hits grant x5 Bolt Charge up to once per lightning bolt.

Pulse: Damaging an enemy creates an Ionic Trace with a 1 second cooldown. Deals up to 25% increased damage as it lingers.
1st = 2% | 2nd = 9% | 3rd = 18.5% | 4th = 24% | 5th onwards = 25%

Storm: Creates a roaming storm for 4.5+1.5 seconds after detonating, chasing after enemies at an initial speed of 2 [1.5] m/s, increasing to 5.5 [3] m/s after 1.6 seconds.
Roaming Storm fires lightning bolts underneath it that deal 164 [30] damage up to 11+4 times.
entries.inCalculator: Needs a keyword the calculator does not have yet. Gives a bonus without a source for its bucket.

entries.name: Trapper's Ambush
entries.inGame:
[Air Move] triggers Quickfall, consuming a Class Ability Charge.
Triggers the effects of the equipped Class Ability on usage. Quickfall retriggers Invisibility if said buff is active.

Quickfall:
Performs a slam, dealing up to 630 [71 Guardians | 700 Constructs] Void Damage over ? meters.
Damage is increased by 50% while a Void Buff is active.
Restores ? HP upon dealing damage.
Kills grant Devour for 10+5 seconds.
–––––
While Vanishing Step is also equipped:
Quickfall inflicts disorient and weaken to enemies and grants invisibility to the user and allies within 10 meters.

Aspect's damage scales with Class Stat above 100, up to 65% [?%] at 200 Stat.
entries.inCalculator: Active in a window that the rotation opens.

entries.name: Unbreakable
entries.inGame:
Hold [Grenade] to summon a Void Shield.
Overrides Grenade Ability Cooldown to 152 seconds at base while equipped.

Void Shield:
Grants 95?% [64%] Damage Resist against blocked damage, and taunts Combatants in front of the user. Combatants that come into contact with the shield become disoriented.
Generates 10 Void Overshield HP/s that lasts 5+2.5 seconds while draining 7.5% Grenade Energy/s.
Blocking damage decreases Forward Movement Speed by 50?% for 0.5? seconds.
Blocking damage grants Grenade Energy. Energy gains are progressively reduced (over time) OR (as Unbreakable gains damage)?, down to ?% Energy after ? seconds.
Void Shield has no Movement Speed Penalties, only restricting mantling. Sprinting cancels Void Shield.

While Sentinel Shield Super Ability is equipped:
Guarding against any damage spawns an Orb of Power that grants 2.5% Super Energy to allies.
Incurs a 4.5 second cooldown between Orb of Power spawns.

Releasing [Grenade] or running out of Grenade Energy releases a frontal blast, consuming 50% Grenade Energy and dealing damage up to 11 meters away.
Deals a minimum of 430 [64?] Grenade Damage for not blocking any damage, scaling to 1584 [178?] damage after receiving a lot [?] blocked damage.

Unbreakable Kills grant Devour for 10+5 seconds.
entries.inCalculator: Active the whole damage phase.

[Air Move] grants Weavewalk and instantly consumes 20% Melee Ability Energy.

Generates a Perched Threadlings every 0.5 seconds. Grants 90% [90%, 60% while carrying Spark] Damage Resist.
Drains 25% Melee Ability Energy per second.
Functionally identical to Void Invisibility.
Arc Souls, No Time To Explain's Time-slip Portal, and Threadlings deal 50% Decreased Damage.
Unable to use Weapon, Abilities, or perform revives. Cannot pick up ammo or Orbs of Power.

Upon exiting Weavewalk:
Grants Woven Mail to the user and allies within ? meters.
Duration scales from 2 seconds, up to a maximum of 20 seconds after being in Weavewalk for ? seconds.

20% of Magazine + 1, rounded down.

entries.name: Thread of Isolation
entries.inGame:
Upon scoring multiple Precision Hits within 2 seconds of each:
Emits a Severing Burst, inflicting Sever to enemies within ? metres.
Incurs a 4 second cooldown upon Severing. Precision Hits during the cooldown will not be counted.

Precision Hits work on a Counter System, triggering the Severing Burst upon reaching 100%.
Counter System is exclusively Weapon Archetype based.

Counter Progress per Precision Hit:
50% Counter: Slug Shotguns
34% Counter: Bows and Sniper Rifles
25% Counter: Hand Cannons and Scout Rifles
20% Counter: Sidearms
15% Counter: Auto Rifles
12% Counter: Machine Guns and Pulse Rifles
10% Counter: Trace Rifles and Submachine Guns

entries.name: Targeting Autoloader
entries.inGame:
Auto Rifle Combatant Kills progress a Counter.
Kills grant 50% Counter Progress.
Kills while within 15 meters of 3 enemies grants 100% Progress.
Kills while at 5 stacks grant 100% Progress.
Counter Progress persists through stow.

Upon reaching 100% Counter Progress:
Grants a stack of Targeting Autoloader for 15 seconds, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.
Buff is refreshable.

Targeting Autoloader:
Refills 20% | 20% | 30% | 40% | 40% of Magazine
10% | 13% | 16% | 18% | 20% Increased Auto Rifle Damage.
Stacks with other buffs.
Buff is removed upon readying a non-Auto Rifle Weapon.
entries.inCalculator: A switch in the Effects list.

entries.name: Void Weapon Channeling
entries.inGame:
Upon scoring a Void Weapon Kill while having at least 1 charged Void Ability:

Grants Weapon Surge stacks equal to the amount of Void Grenade, Melee, Class, and Super Ability Charges for 11 seconds.

Up to x4 Weapon Surge by having 4 Void Ability Charges.
2 Grenade + 2 Melee = x4 | Grenade + Melee + Class + Super = x4

Buff can only be refreshed if the stack amount is less or equal (≤) to the amount of Void Ability Charges.

Works as expected on Prismatic!
